title: Styleguide page definition
description: The `page/<id>/<id>.yaml` contract. A page is a styleguide catalogue entry that composes components. It is not a component: it has no editor fields, no CMS projection (no acf.json, block.json or component.yml) and no `kind`. The keys below are the ones parisek/styleguide's ComponentParser reads for a page. Shapes shared with component.fields.schema.json are copied, not referenced, and PageSchemaParityTest keeps the copies identical.

usage.description: The components this page renders. Maintained by the update-usage skill.

render.description: Iframe-wrapper mode for the styleguide preview. Mirrors ComponentParser::RENDER_MODES in parisek/styleguide.

web.description: Link to the live page for this entry. Either a site-relative path, which starts with `/` and not with `//`, or an absolute http(s) URL whose host starts and ends with a letter or digit, with an optional port; the scheme matches case-insensitively. A protocol-relative `//host`, another scheme (`ftp:`, `javascript:`) and a bare `example.com` fail, and so does any whitespace. Userinfo (`user@host`) and an IPv6 literal host are not accepted. Consumers use the value as an href unchanged and resolve only a relative path against the environment.

asana.description: Link to the tracking task. An absolute http(s) URL whose host is asana.com or a subdomain of it; scheme and host match case-insensitively. The pattern checks the host, not the whole string, so `https://example.com/asana.com` fails, and it rejects whitespace anywhere in the value. It spells out case classes instead of a `(?i)` flag, which ECMA-262 regex does not support.

drupal.description: Link to the Drupal admin screen for this entry. Either a site-relative path, which starts with `/` and not with `//`, or an absolute http(s) URL whose host starts and ends with a letter or digit, with an optional port; the scheme matches case-insensitively. A protocol-relative `//host`, another scheme (`ftp:`, `javascript:`) and a bare `example.com` fail, and so does any whitespace. Userinfo (`user@host`) and an IPv6 literal host are not accepted. Consumers use the value as an href unchanged and resolve only a relative path against the environment.

description.description: What this page is. Shown as the sidebar tooltip and on the overview card.

dev.description: Notes for the DEVELOPER working on this page. Stays in the YAML: the styleguide does not read it.

body_class.description: Class string the styleguide puts on the render iframe's <body>, after the global `iframe.body_class`. Mirrors what the production layout puts on <body>.

variants.description: LEGACY fallback for the display metadata of `styleguide.<variant>.twig` siblings. The primary convention is a `{# title: … description: … #}` comment in the sibling file itself.

design.description: Links parts of this entry to elements of a design source, per viewport. Tool-agnostic: a source id names a source the project declares once (test-kit: a side), and the project declares its kind there (render, structured or raster), never here. definition-kit validates the shape only. Each `part` is unique in the list. No CMS projection: the key reaches neither acf.json nor block.json.

part.description: Name of the part, unique in this definition. `root` is the component element.

site.description: CSS selector of the part inside the render. Default: the component root.

target.description: Render that shows the part, for example `page/example-full`. Default: this entry's own styleguide render.

repeat.description: The selectors match a list; the consumer compares the matches by index.

sources.description: Source id => viewport id => reference. Both ids are the project's own free strings.

ref.description: What the source's provider resolves: a file, a path against the source's origin, or a node id.

select.description: Element inside the ref: a CSS selector (render) or a node path (structured). Not together with `region`.

region.description: Area of a raster image in CSS px at `scale`. Not together with `select`.

scale.description: Device scale of a raster image. The consumer defaults it to 1.

state.description: Name of the state the ref shows, for example hover, open or error.

reveal.description: Steps that bring the render into the same state. Same shape as a test-kit settle.reveal step, so a consumer passes the list on unchanged.

variantsOrder.description: Variant tile ids to show first; the rest keep file-name order.

aliases.description: Extra search names: a string opens the entry, `{name, variant}` opens that variant tile. Shared between component, page and doc — older `parisek/styleguide` versions ignore the key.

multivalueAnnotation.description: Either guidance, or an explicit decision that none is needed. A bare key (`mcp:`, parsing as null) means DELIBERATELY NONE — tooling that reports un-annotated components must stay silent about it, which an absent key cannot express. An empty string and an empty array stay invalid on purpose: they are almost always a half-finished edit, and allowing them would give one decision three spellings.
